banklight_vs_placebo.interpretation: No observed whole-run win effect in this small dependent screen; not proof of a universal zero effect.

decision: No P9 candidate selected. The banked mechanic activates but often below its payoff threshold. Test fixed-full-stock-peak payoff shapes next rather than increasing every payoff. The no-card comparison changes the reward-pool mapping; use the same-pool placebo for the resource-slope contrast.
